_readme: Shot prompts for generated demo footage (pipeline/generate.mjs, Runway). Runway animates a generated still, so the prompt field composes the frame and the motion field describes what moves: framing is won or lost in the still. Framing now asks for the whole body head to feet; the earlier head-cropping instructions existed only to satisfy the faceless rule and cost every shot its natural composition. Motion prompts ask for three repetitions and describe only movement: the first character run asked for one repetition with the framing line appended and produced a held pose, no rep at all. Runway caps promptText at 1000 characters, so every line here is written tight and the builder verifies the composed length before spending a call. Faces are allowed here (owner override, 2026-09-03) because the person is synthetic, and she is one recurring character pinned by assets/character.json. The t-shirt in the wardrobe line is a production choice, not a brand rule: a cropped top rides up through a glute bridge or a plank, and generated video mangles an exposed midriff. Every line is written positively, with no negations: two casting rounds established that Runway drops them, so "no crop top" reliably produced a crop top. State what is in the frame, never what is not. Generation produces candidates only; full-motion editorial review is the only way into assets/demo-library.json.
look: Cinematic 35mm film look, fine grain, warm neutral grade, true skin texture with visible pores, plain unmarked surfaces.
camera: Locked-off tripod, 50mm, shallow depth of field, defocused background.
light: Soft daylight from one large window at frame left, deep natural shadow falloff.
room: Plain modern apartment, bone-white walls, warm oak floor, charcoal mat, minimal furniture, empty of equipment.
wardrobe: A forty-year-old white European woman with blonde hair tied back, fair freckled skin, a soft average build, bare-faced, wearing a loose oatmeal cotton t-shirt that hangs to her hips, charcoal leggings, barefoot.
framing: Full body in frame from head to feet, camera at chest height, generous margin so no limb is cropped.

Wall Push-Up.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing at arm's length from a bone-white wall, palms planted flat at chest height, elbows softly bent, weight forward onto the balls of her feet, body in one straight line from heel to shoulder.
Wall Push-Up.motion: She bends her elbows and lowers her chest all the way to the wall, then presses back until her arms are straight. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Incline Push-Up.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman with both palms on the front edge of a low oak sofa, arms straight, feet walked back, body angled in one clean line from heel to shoulder.
Incline Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest all the way to the sofa edge, then presses back to straight arms. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Kneeling Push-Up.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman on a charcoal mat, knees down and ankles crossed, palms under her shoulders, hips in line with her spine.
Kneeling Push-Up.framing: Camera low beside the mat at floor level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Kneeling Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest to the mat and presses back up. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Full Push-Up.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman holding a full push-up position on a charcoal mat, hands under her shoulders, body in one straight line from heel to shoulder.
Full Push-Up.framing: Camera low beside the mat at floor level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Full Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest to a hand's width above the mat and presses back to straight arms. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Air Squat.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing on a warm oak floor, feet hip-width apart, arms reaching forward at shoulder height, weight settled through the mid-foot.
Air Squat.motion: She sits her hips back and down until her thighs are parallel to the floor, then drives up to standing. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Wall Sit.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman with her back flat against a bone-white wall, knees bent to ninety degrees, shins vertical, hands resting lightly on her thighs.
Wall Sit.motion: She holds the position while her thighs tremble and her chest rises and falls with each breath.

Sit-to-Stand.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman seated on the front edge of a plain oak dining chair, arms folded across her chest, feet flat and set back beneath her knees.
Sit-to-Stand.motion: She leans forward, stands up tall without her hands, then lowers back to the seat. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Reverse Lunge.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing tall on a warm oak floor, hands clasped at her chest, weight settled on the front foot.
Reverse Lunge.motion: She steps one foot back and lowers the back knee towards the floor, then drives up to standing. Three full repetitions, alternating legs.

Split Squat.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman in a split stance on a warm oak floor, front foot flat, back heel lifted, torso upright and tall.
Split Squat.motion: She lowers straight down until her back knee nearly touches the floor, then presses back up. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Glute Bridge.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman lying on a charcoal mat, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width, arms resting palms-down by her sides.
Glute Bridge.framing: Camera low at hip level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Glute Bridge.motion: She drives her hips up until knees, hips and shoulders line up, holds a beat, then lowers to the mat. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Hip Thrust.prompt: Low side-on shot of a woman with her upper back resting against the front edge of a low oak sofa, knees bent, feet flat on the floor, hips lowered toward the ground.
Hip Thrust.framing: Camera low at hip level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Hip Thrust.motion: She drives her hips up until they are level with her knees and shoulders, then lowers under control. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Standing Hip Hinge.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing tall on a warm oak floor, hands flat on the front of her thighs, knees softly bent, spine long and neutral.
Standing Hip Hinge.motion: She pushes her hips back and slides her hands down her thighs with a flat back, then stands tall. Three full repetitions, continuous and unhurried.

Full Plank.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman on a charcoal mat in a forearm plank, elbows stacked under her shoulders, body in one straight line from heel to shoulder.
Full Plank.framing: Camera low beside the mat at floor level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Full Plank.motion: She holds the plank while her chest rises and falls with each breath and her shoulders shift a little under the effort.

Knee Plank.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman in a forearm plank from her knees on a charcoal mat, elbows under her shoulders, hips level with her spine.
Knee Plank.framing: Camera low beside the mat at floor level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Knee Plank.motion: She holds the position while her chest rises and falls with each breath.

Side Plank.prompt: Low shot of a woman on a charcoal mat in a side plank on one forearm, hips lifted and stacked, top arm resting along her side, feet stacked.
Side Plank.framing: Camera low at hip level, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Side Plank.motion: She holds the side plank, hips lifted and steady, breathing evenly.

Doorframe Row.prompt: Medium shot from behind and slightly to one side of a woman gripping both edges of an open white doorframe, arms straight, leaning her weight back with heels planted.
Doorframe Row.framing: Shot from behind at shoulder height, her whole body in frame from head to feet.
Doorframe Row.motion: She pulls her chest towards the doorframe until her shoulder blades draw together, then lowers back out with straight arms. Three full repetitions.

Seated Knee Lift.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman sitting tall on the front edge of an oak dining chair, hands resting on the seat beside her hips, spine long, feet flat.
Seated Knee Lift.motion: She lifts one knee towards her chest and lowers it, then lifts the other. Four repetitions, alternating, continuous and unhurried.

environments._readme: Environment scenes outnumber demo scenes 35 to 1 in a week, and they are what failed week 01's review. The query in a sidecar is already a shot description, so a prompt is composed from it rather than written per query: the query, the framing, the setting its keywords select, then the shared wardrobe, light, camera and look. She is in every one of them, because CLAUDE.md is right that a room with nobody in it reads as stock footage.
environments.framing: Close handheld shot of her hands, feet or back filling the frame, shallow focus, the rest of her body soft behind.

settings.apartment: Her own plain apartment: bone-white walls, warm oak floor, a low sofa and a charcoal mat, minimal furniture, empty of equipment.
settings.hotel_room: A plain business hotel room: neutral walls, a made bed, blackout curtains half drawn, a city window.
settings.kitchen: A small home kitchen: pale counter, oak cabinets, a kettle, an oven, daylight from one window.
settings.stairwell: A residential stairwell: painted handrail, worn stone steps, daylight from a landing window.
settings.office: A quiet corner of an open-plan office: a plain desk, a laptop, a mesh chair, a glass partition.
settings.bedroom: Her bedroom in the evening: a lamp on low, curtains drawn, a charcoal mat on the floor, deep shadow.
